title: Order By Length Worksheets | 1st Math Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: 1.MD.A.1, 1.MD.A.2

Give your learners extra practice with Order By Length! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Longest and Shortest
  • Which Is in the Middle?
  • Three Ribbons
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
